objects.description: During [C0027](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0027), [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) used Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) to move laterally via [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357).(Citation: Crowdstrike TELCO BPO Campaign December 2022)
